description: All Rule-2 insider-buy signals for one ticker (case-insensitive). Returns the newest 25 by default (set `limit`; page with `offset`; optional `days`); `total_matched` reports the full count. Each record carries its source filing_url.

days.description: Only rows filed within the last N days (relative to today).

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 25, newest first). Page with offset; the response's total_matched shows the full count. limit<=0 = no cap.

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page (pagination). Default 0.

name: insider_signals_by_ticker
title: Insider-buy signals for a ticker
